pages.text: The $(item)Vitality Compass$() is a mystical tool infused with a $(#AA00AA)Foliot$()$(br) that allows it to be attuned to the essence of living beings.$(br) By right-clicking on a creature, you bind its life force to the compass,$(br) allowing the $()
needle to always point toward its location no matter the distance (while loaded).$(br)
